name: aiharness
description: Marmelab's agent harness: an implementation pipeline where subagents (planner, developer, quality-reviewer, merger, documentator) carry a change through git worktrees under deterministic hook enforcement. Every gate is a hook rather than a prompt instruction, so it fires whether or not the model cooperates. Ships the enforcement core, the agent team, the generic skills, and a Supabase deploy adapter. Projects supply a harness.config.json and their own domain skills.
